cli help.out:
Riley inference server (OpenAI-compatible HTTP API).

  serve --preset NAME [riley serve options]
      Download the preset into /models/NAME on first use, then serve it with
      --model-id NAME --inference-profile native-bf16-varlen-v1 --bind 0.0.0.0:8080
      and a weight limit that fits the checkpoint. Options you pass win.
  serve --model DIR --model-id ID [options]
      Serve a checkpoint you prepared yourself (listens on 0.0.0.0:8080).
  download NAME...      Download and verify presets into /models.
  presets               List bundled presets.
  riley-checkpoint ...  Run the checkpoint tool (prepare, verify, download).
  --version, --help     Passed to riley; so is any other command.

Gated models need HF_TOKEN in the environment. Presets:

cli riley-checkpoint --help.out:
riley-checkpoint (offline by default)
prepare --manifest PLAN.json --source REGULAR_DIRECTORY --destination NEW_DIRECTORY
verify --checkpoint DIRECTORY
download --manifest PLAN.json --destination NEW_DIRECTORY --allow-network [--token-env HF_TOKEN]
Download requires the separately compiled `hub` feature. Branches/tags are rejected.
The manifest is an independently trusted explicit file/size/SHA-256 allowlist.
Never serve or edit a checkpoint until this command succeeds; verify after an interruption.
